Package state_machine.core

Class GameStateMachine

  • java.lang.Object
    • state_machine.standard.StateMachine
      • state_machine.core.GameStateMachine
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Launchable, Subroutine, StateAPI
    public final class GameStateMachine
extends StateMachine

    A class representing a state machine for a game application. Example uses could be for a MenuState, IntroState, GameplayState, InventoryState, etc..

    This state machine should not be used for game objects as this defeats the purpose of the entity-component-system architecture, although this maybe possible...
